source: Egyptian Exchange results disclosure (audited FY2025); financial indicators via Arab Finance and Mubasher
source_note: FY2025 net profit is the audited figure in Gogreen's results disclosure to the Egyptian Exchange for the year ended 31 December 2025 (Net Profit 55,952,921 EGP, comparative FY2024 57,396,368 EGP, Audit Status Audited), read from the exchange disclosure summary. Revenue for FY2025 and FY2024 is the sales line in the same financial indicators disclosures; FY2023 revenue, net profit and the FY2024 and FY2023 EPS are as reported by Arab Finance from those disclosures. The panel's Cost of Sales, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, Operating Profit, Net Finance Costs, Profit Before Tax and Income Tax rows stay empty: the free disclosure summaries publish revenue and net profit only, so those lines are not sourced. A previously stored Gross Profit and Net Profit pair from a Mubasher summary was removed: it carried a FY2025 net profit of 7,161,824 EGP against the audited 55,952,921 EGP, so that summary's columns disagree with the filing and none of them can be relied on.
name: GoGreen for Agricultural Investments Inc.
alias_note: Same issuer as GGRN: the EGX listing carries this security under both the ticker GGRN and the ISIN EGS07DR1C012. Both keys carry the same statement so the panel resolves whichever key it reads.

superseded.reason: Replaced by the audited Egyptian Exchange results disclosure for FY2025. This earlier pair came from a Mubasher statement summary whose FY2025 net profit of 7,161,824 EGP contradicts the audited 55,952,921 EGP, so its columns are not a reliable reading of the filing and both figures were withheld rather than kept.
